title: Ethereum trapped in a range: Flipping $2,530 will clear the path to $3,000
summary: Ethereum has formed a range around the $2.5k resistance, right by the $2,466 high from April.
content: Ethereum is currently trading within a defined price range, facing notable resistance around the $2,500 level. Market analysts note that a successful breakout and flip of the $2,530 mark could clear the technical path for the cryptocurrency to advance toward the $3,000 psychological milestone, following patterns established near previous highs.

summary:

The post Law Schools Outlaw AI Amid Fears of Stunted Academic Growth appeared first on PYMNTS.com.
content: Law schools in the United States, including the University of Chicago Law School, are banning artificial intelligence and electronic devices like phones, tablets, and laptops in first-year classrooms. Institutions are implementing these restrictions for the new academic year amid growing concerns that technology could stunt academic growth.

title: UK financial watchdog weighs lifting prediction markets ban: Report
summary: Companies offering binary options for retail investors have been barred from selling, marketing and distributing products in the UK since 2019 following a directive from the FCA.
content: The UK financial watchdog is reportedly weighing whether to lift its ban on prediction markets. Since 2019, companies offering binary options and related products to retail investors have been barred from selling, marketing, and distributing them in the country following a directive from the Financial Conduct Authority.

title: Mining 50 BTC for $5.68 Looked Too Expensive 16 Years Ago
summary: A 2010 Bitcoin forum post shows an early miner calling the $5.68 electricity cost of producing a block containing 50 BTC “a net loser.”.
content: A resurfaced 2010 forum post highlights the early days of cryptocurrency mining, showing a user complaining that spending $5.68 in electricity to mine 50 Bitcoin was too expensive. At the time, the miner considered the transaction a net loss, demonstrating how dramatically sentiment and the digital asset's valuation have changed over the past sixteen years.

title: Ethereum Foundation names 2 ‘must ship’ EIPs for Hegotá upgrade
summary: Ethereum’s Hegotá upgrade will center on FOCIL and Frame Transactions as developers weigh dozens of other proposed changes for inclusion.
content: The Ethereum Foundation has designated two specific Ethereum Improvement Proposals, known as FOCIL and Frame Transactions, as 'must ship' features for the upcoming Hegotá upgrade. While developers are evaluating numerous proposed changes for potential inclusion in the network upgrade, these two central proposals have been prioritized for development and deployment.
